signals.summary: Reco opens a new physical office in Texas and expands its footprint into the United Kingdom and Ireland.
signals.evidence: Reco is opening a physical office in Texas, where the company has operated with dedicated team members and enterprise customers.

signals.summary: Reco appointed Zoe Hillenmeyer as Chief Operating Officer, Kristen Twining as Senior Vice President of Americas Sales and Business Development, Dana Harduf as Chief Human Resources Officer, Sandy Mathews as Vice President of Product Marketing, and Merav Keren Kindler as Vice President of Marketing.
signals.evidence: The company has named Zoe Hillenmeyer as Chief Operating Officer.

signals.summary: Reco received three Global InfoSec Awards in 2026 for Market Innovator SaaS/Cloud Security, Market Leader AI Security Solution, and Pioneering GenAI Cybersecurity.
signals.evidence: The company also received three Global InfoSec Awards in 2026 for Market Innovator SaaS/Cloud Security, Market Leader AI Security Solution, and Pioneering GenAI Cybersecurity
